The bureaus of the empire are centrally managed in the city, with various branches reporting to their respective ministries in the capital who report to the Emperor and other powerbrokers. Known institutions are the [[Ministry of Sentinel Affairs]], responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars, with limited powers over other administrative bodies; the [[Ministry of War]], headed by its Grand Marshall; the ''Censorate'', one of Huanglong's three judicial bodies; the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs]], in charge of tracking events in other nations; the [[Internal Security Agency]], a secret police with extraordinary powers and specialized expertise in managing Resonators; and [[Huaxu Academy]], the country's principal research facilities. ==Resonators== ===Playable Resonators=== {{Resonators by Category Table|Playable Resonators&Huanglong Resonators}} ===Upcoming Resonators=== {{Resonators by Category Table|Upcoming Resonators&Huanglong Resonators}} ==Military== ===Mengzhou=== {{Main|Xuanfang Wardens}} Under the Ministry of War in Mengzhou, the soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens, lead by Paragon [[Qingxiao]]. They act as the military of Xuanfang, assisting Autopuppets in defending the region. The Xuan Triad is a special unit formed by the Xuanfang Wardens, composed of three elite Wardens. Members of this unit are also known as Xuan Watchers. The Xuan Triad is tasked with handling incidents beyond the capabilities of standard Xuanfang Wardens. Despite their abilities, Xuanfang is primarily defended by the numerically superior Autopuppets. ===Jinzhou=== {{Main|Midnight Rangers}}The [[Midnight Rangers]] are the primary military force of Huanglong's frontlines in Jinzhou, protecting the province and nation as a whole from the Tacet Discord threat emerging from [[Norfall Barrens]]. The Rangers' facilities line the northern half of the province, all the way down to the provincial capital where threats are either flooded, repulsed, or redirected towards the [[Gorges of Spirits]] and the pathway towards Xuanfang's defenses, consisting of the Disorienting Fog and automata. They report to the Ministry of War in Mingting. The Midnight Rangers are led by Sentinal [[Jué]]'s appointed General, [[Jiyan]]. ==Trivia== *In [[Version/Closed Beta I|CBT1]] Huanglong lore-wise consisted only of the parts of [[Jinzhou (Province)|Jinzhou]] present at [[Version/1.0|release]]. The other provinces did not exist. *{{w|Huanglong Scenic and Historic Interest Area|Huanglong}} {{Lang|zhs=黄龙}}{{Lang|zht=黃龍}} is a scenic and historic interest area in the northwest part of {{w|Sichuan}}, China. ===Etymology=== *{{Lang|Huánglóng|zh=瑝珑}} is the sound of tinkling jade. *The {{Lang|zh=𤣩}} radical represents jade-related words. {{Lang|Lóng|zh=珑}} is "sound of tinkling jade", or "a jade with dragon design used to pray for rain". *Without the {{Lang|zh=𤣩}} radical, {{Lang|Huáng|zh=皇}} is "king", and {{Lang|Lóng|zh=龙}} is "dragon". *{{Lang|Huánglóng|zh=黄龙}} is "Yellow dragon". ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Huanglong |zhs = 瑝珑 |zht = 瑝瓏 |ja = 瑝瓏 |ko = 황룡 |es = Huanglong |fr = Huanglong |de = Huanglong |th = หวงหลง |pt = Huanglong }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Navigation== {{Faction Navbox}} {{Location Navbox|Huanglong}} [[ru:Хуанлун]] [[zh:瑝珑]]
